title: expectrail.repro-score/v1
description: The reproduction rate of one live run on the public reproduction bench: per defect, whether a generated check passed on the clean game 3 times of 3 and failed on the bug build 3 times of 3, read from that run's jit-run records. Every defect runs with the same stand-in candidate, a comment line that changes nothing, so the check comes from the bug build and the report alone. A defect with no usable record is no-result and never counts as reproduced. A miss carries a reason only where the records can show one. Written and read by expectrail.repro.score.

reason.description: The issue's vocabulary (#285, step 2), and undetermined. The scorer assigns budget, flaky, wrong-predicate, no-signal and undetermined; no record separates route-never-reaches or probe-language from the others, so a record that carries one of those is refused.

benchSha256.description: The bench file the defects were read from.

noFixSha256.description: The stand-in candidate every case ran with.

visibilitySha256.description: The visibility record the rows' visibility came from, or null when none was given.

source.description: Where the jit-run records came from, as the person who scored them said: a CI run, for example. Not checked. One line: no control character.

offer.description: What the generator was offered in the records this score counts (expectrail/jit/offer.py). A record made with another setting is a row with no result.

visibility.description: What the library probes see of this defect, copied from the visibility record; null when it has no row for it.

why.description: For no-result: why there is no result. One line: no control character.

kept.description: Checks that passed on the clean game 3 of 3 and failed 3 of 3 on a near miss, worked out from the runs.

reproducing.description: The kept checks that failed 3 of 3 on the bug build, with and without the no-fix candidate. The bug build's three fails are read from the check's catch entry in the jit-run record, which keeps those runs.

evidence.description: For a miss: what in the records gives the reason. One line: no control character.

traceVisible.description: Defects whose visibility is signal or trace-only: the engine's record differs on some library probe.
